[6:18AM] #EbuteEro #Apongnon #TrafficUpdate 

Movement on Eko bridge  by NEPA intersection inward Apongbon  is looking good.

Descending Eko bridge inward & ascending CMS bridge to connect CMS  is good to go.

Descending Eko bridge inward Elegbeta Mini stadium, EBUTE-ERO market to  connect Eko bridge is good to go.

Descending from Carter bridge inward EBUTE-ERO market, Leventis through UBA roundabout to connect inner and outer Marina is also good to go.

Good movement on Broad street stretch to Apongbon underneath the bridge to connect Offin Canal market and Olowogbowo.

Good  movement on CMS bridge inward Offin Canal market stretch to Ijora Olopa by NEPA intersection.
